_comment: Permissions for the per-ride Claude thread (ride-thread-run.sh).
The rider is on a bus. Every permission prompt this session raises lands
in their phone app and stops the watcher until they tap it, so the whole
routine job -- read telemetry, grep it, build a fixture, write the vault
report -- has to be allowed up front. Anything NOT listed here still
is REFUSED (the mode is dontAsk since 2026-09-24, backlog 12.4 reopened):
under the old manual mode it prompted, and a prompt mid-ride is a hang.
The deny list encodes the standing mid-ride prohibitions (never edit code,
never restart a service, never deploy): denies beat allows, so even the
broad project .claude/settings.json this session also loads cannot let the
thread hot-reload the phone the rider is navigating by.
Two things learned the hard way (the CLI prints a warning for the first):
file rules must be written as Edit(path) -- a Write(path) rule matches
nothing, and Edit(path) already covers every file-editing tool; and the
permission MODE is pinned on the command line in ride-thread-run.sh,
because defaultMode here loses to the mode the project last had.
A third, found during the end-to-end run: an env-var PREFIX defeats a
command rule (`DEBUG_LOG_DIR=... node build-fixture.js` matched no rule
and prompted the rider mid-wrap-up), so the prefixed forms are listed
explicitly and the sysprompt tells the thread to prefer --logs-dir.
The one POST allowed here is /api/ride-note on localhost: notes the rider
types straight into this conversation are otherwise invisible to the
daemon (2026-08-02: three notes, `0 note(s)` in the wrap-up), and this
puts them into the same stream the console writes to.
A fourth, and the one that cost five consecutive wrap-ups (backlog 12.4):
ONE command outside this list stops the thread dead. ride-0957 issued
`... | awk 'NR<4 || NR%12==0'` at 10:10:16 and emitted nothing for the
eleven minutes until its pane was retired; awk was not listed. awk, sed -n
echo and tr are now listed for that reason -- they are the shapes a
telemetry slice actually takes. sed -i is denied: this thread never edits.
The OTHER half of 12.4 is not expressible here at all. The deny rules
Read(**/secrets/**) and Read(//home/rwt/.config/pushover/**) make any
RELATIVE file read unresolvable, so `cd X && grep -n foo bar.md` raises
"Compound command contains `cd` with a relative file read while a Read()
deny rule exists -- Do you want to proceed?" however many commands are
allowed. Caught live 2026-09-08 12:09 and again 2026-09-09 09:46:48. The
fix for that one is in ride-thread-sysprompt.md: absolute paths, no cd.
A fifth (backlog 15.8, 2026-09-13): the wrap-up's step 3 now promotes each
real bug into ~/.claude/plans/please-make-a-centralized-sharded-petal.md,
so Edit() on that directory is allowed. Without the rule the promotion
raises exactly the prompt 12.4 is about and the thread dies mid-wrap-up;
with the old step-3 wording it never tried at all, which is why the five
triaged findings of the 09-13 Green Line ride reached no backlog.
A sixth (2026-09-21): the daemon no longer types into this pane. It
appends milestones to <name>.events.log and the thread watches that file
with the Monitor tool, armed by its kickoff prompt -- so Monitor is
allowed, and tail (already listed) is what it runs underneath.
A seventh (2026-09-24, 12.4 reopened): three wrap-ups were lost to prompts
after 12.4 closed, the last on a multi-line `python3 -c` behind a pipe.
Every new command shape was a new way to hang, so the mode is now dontAsk:
an unmatched call is refused and the turn continues. The daemon's
thread-blocked page stays as the backstop for anything that still asks.
